agentCertification.reason: 0 certified is the honest, correct state. Certification requires a REAL evaluation benchmark (>=10 cases/agent, >=2x repeats for reproducibility, policy-compliance=1.0, correctness>=0.9, FP<=0.05, FN<=0.1, evidence>=0.95, reproducibility>=0.95, recovery>=0.9) decided by a certifier that is NOT the agent (no self-cert). No such benchmark has been executed, and the 72 agents are schema-validated ROLE DEFINITIONS (least-privilege invariants enforced), not executable model versions with a benchmark harness on this host. Certifying them without real evaluation evidence would fabricate metrics (forbidden: NO_FAKE_PASS, SELF-LEARNING!=SELF-TRUSTING, certify-before-active). The certification mechanism (packages/agent-evaluation) exists and is tested (15 tests) and enforces the gate; nothing promotes an uncertified agent to ACTIVE.
